user.title: Connect to Bus Open Data Service
user.description: Enter your free BODS API key once. Bus stops are added separately beneath this account.

data_description.api_key: Create a free account at data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk and copy the API key from your account.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to BODS
reauth_confirm.description: The BODS API key is no longer being accepted. Enter a replacement key; all configured stops will continue to use it.

error.invalid_auth: The BODS API key was rejected.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.account_already_configured: A BODS account is already configured. Add another bus stop to the existing BODS Bus Tracker entry instead.

user.title: Add a bus stop
user.description: Choose a BODS timetable region and search by stop name, ATCO code or NaPTAN/SMS code. Automatic region detection requires an exact stop code.

data_description.region: Choose a region to search by name, or Auto detect when you already know the exact stop code.
data_description.stop_search: Examples: The Fairway, 3100Z199842, or nldawjgp. The exact stop normally determines the direction of travel.

stop_select.title: Select the exact stop
stop_select.description: Several stops matched your search. Choose the exact boarding point/direction.

services.title: Choose services
services.description: {stop_name} ({stop_atco}) was found in {region}. Select the services to include at this stop.

data_description.services: Available route/operator combinations discovered from the regional GTFS timetable. Destination/headsigns are shown where BODS supplies them.
data_description.stop_view: Departures preserves the existing boarding-time behaviour at intermediate stops. Arrivals shows buses reaching the stop. Arrivals and departures is intended for termini; Next bus and Leave now remain tied to the next boardable departure.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll BODS vehicle locations for this stop. 30 seconds is recommended.
data_description.walking_time: Fallback minutes from your usual starting point to this boarding stop. Set to 0 if you want leave guidance disabled whenever the dynamic travel-time sensor is unavailable.
data_description.dynamic_walking_time: When enabled, use a Home Assistant travel-time sensor (for example HERE Travel Time or Google Maps Travel Time in walking mode) instead of the static value whenever the sensor is valid.
data_description.walking_time_entity: Select the sensor whose state is the routed walking duration. Supported duration units are seconds, minutes and hours. The sensor is read only; BODS Bus Tracker does not call the routing provider or store its API key.

reconfigure.title: Configure bus stop
reconfigure.description: Change the services, stop view, walking guidance and polling interval for {stop_name} ({stop_atco}). To monitor a different boarding point, add another stop and remove this one.

data_description.stop_view: Departures is recommended for ordinary intermediate boarding stops. Use Arrivals or Arrivals and departures where the distinction is useful, especially at a terminus.
data_description.poll_interval: Each stop can use its own live update interval. 30 seconds is recommended.
data_description.walking_time: Fallback walking minutes. Existing static behaviour is unchanged when routed dynamic walking time is disabled.
data_description.dynamic_walking_time: Use the selected Home Assistant routed travel-time sensor when valid, falling back automatically to the static walking time if it is unavailable, invalid or stale.
data_description.walking_time_entity: A duration sensor created by a routing integration such as HERE Travel Time or Google Maps Travel Time. Configure that provider separately with walking mode and a dynamic person/device-tracker origin.

error.auto_requires_stop_code: Automatic region detection requires an exact ATCO/NaPTAN stop code. Choose a region if you want to search by name.
error.gtfs_download_failed: Unable to download a valid regional GTFS timetable.
error.invalid_auth: The BODS API key was rejected.
error.no_services: The stop was found but no BODS services with operator identifiers could be discovered.
error.stop_not_found_all_regions: That exact stop code was not found in the available BODS regional timetables.
error.stop_search_no_results: No stops matched that name or code in the selected region.
error.stop_search_required: Enter a stop name or code.
error.stop_selection_invalid: Select one of the discovered stops.
error.walking_time_entity_required: Select a travel-time sensor when routed dynamic walking time is enabled.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
